newsitem.title: USA: Charles Schwab added to S&P 500 index.
newsitem.headline: Charles Schwab added to S&P 500 index.

text.p: The Standard & Poor's Financial Information Services group said Tuesday that it will add The Charles Schwab Corp to its S&P 500 Index after the close of trading on May 30.

The company, a division of The McGraw-Hill Cos, said Schwab would be added to replace Morgan Stanley & Co, which is set to merge with Dean Witter, Discover & Co. on May 31. The new firm resulting from that merger, Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, will retain its place in the index.
Schwab, currently in the S&P MidCap 400 index will be replaced by AGCO Corp, currently in the S&P SmallCap 600 index.
AGCO, in turn, said the company will be replaced by World Color Press Inc.
